description:
This permit is for residential solar photovoltaic (PV) installations, which have already received SolarAPP+ approvals. Contractors can follow the link to find out how to become a certified SolarAPP+ installer:
https://help.solar-app.org/article/15-permit-application

instructions.AttachmentInstructions:
Instructions: 
 Applicants must submit the following 
 Approved SolarAPP+ Inspection Checklist 
 SolarAPP+ Specification Sheets 
Note: All documents to be in PDF format.
instructions.BasicInfoInstructions:
Note: Please enter a detailed scope of work in the description field. Description should include if this is a new or altered system and the size, in kilowatts DD, of the solar array , the total kWh for EES (if applicable) and the SolarAPP+ approval number. 
 Separate permits are required for the following items: Generators, Ground-mounted PV systems, Service upgrades not within SolarAPP scope , Main panel upgrades, New service meter installations, Reroofs as part of solar install. ​

instructions.BasicInfoInstructions:
We require thorough description of the work. The following information is required: 
Does the work involve pavement removal and restoration? 
Is a utility outage required? 
 Is the work proposed to be done during the day or night? The City has a Noise Ordinance and night work is allowed only with the City Engineer’s approval. The applicant shall provide a written explanation of why night work is required well in advance of the project for City review. ​ 
Slurry Seal Moratorium 
 Summer Construction Moratorium 
Valuation will determine miscellaneous costs.
